metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Lewiston, MI
metaDescription: Own mineral rights near Lewiston, Montmorency County? Lakes-country Antrim Shale ground with real, mature production. Get an honest evaluation.
heroLead: Lewiston sits among a string of lakes in Montmorency County, and a lot of the cottage and cabin property here has the mineral rights split off underneath it, the same way most of this county's resort ground does.
intro: Lewiston is an unincorporated community centered around a chain of small lakes in Montmorency County, popular for cottages and seasonal homes. The farm and forest land surrounding those lakes saw Antrim Shale leasing and, in places, drilling during the boom years of the late 1980s and 1990s, and mineral ownership here frequently doesn't match who currently owns the lakefront property.

sections.heading: Cottage country with older mineral history underneath
paragraphs: A lot of the land around Lewiston's lakes changed hands for recreational value over the decades, and mineral rights were commonly reserved by an earlier owner or sold off separately from the surface before the cottage economy took over. If you own a cabin near Lewiston and have never gotten a royalty check, that's likely why, and if you're getting a check tied to land here you don't own the surface of, that's the flip side of the same setup.

sections.heading: Pricing a Lewiston-area mineral interest
paragraphs: Where wells were drilled in sections around Lewiston, they're decades into the same long, flat decline typical of the Antrim core by now. We check current statements and activity before quoting anything, and we'll be upfront that a mature interest here usually means a modest number, not a dramatic one.

sections.heading: What we need to evaluate a Lewiston-area interest
paragraphs: Send your deed or probate document, any royalty statements or division orders you've received, and the legal description if you have it. Because so much of this area's ownership traces through resort-era sales, it helps to know whether the interest passed with the cottage or was kept separate by an earlier family member.
We'll check the recorded chain of title alongside current production before saying anything definite about value.

faqs.question: I own a cottage near Lewiston. Do I own the minerals under it?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Check your deed for mineral reservation language, since a lot of cottage property in this area was sold with the mineral rights kept back by a previous owner.

faqs.question: Is the Lewiston area part of the Antrim Shale trend?
faqs.answer: Yes, Lewiston sits in Montmorency County, within the historic core of the Antrim play, though drilling activity varies by specific section.

faqs.question: How do I check the mineral title history for land near Lewiston?
faqs.answer: The Montmorency County register of deeds in Atlanta holds the recorded chain of title for the whole county, including the Lewiston area.

faqs.question: Why would my family's mineral rights near Lewiston be held separately from our cottage?
faqs.answer: It's common for a seller to reserve mineral rights when selling recreational property, or for the minerals to have been severed generations earlier through a farm-era transaction before the cottage economy took hold.
